INSERT INTO artists (userId, displayName, bio, location, hourlyRate, isVerified, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT id, 'Test Artist', 'Professional test artist for automated testing', 'Raleigh, NC', 100, 1, NOW(), NOW()
FROM users WHERE openId = 'test-artist-openid-67890'
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE displayName=VALUES(displayName), bio=VALUES(bio), location=VALUES(location), hourlyRate=VALUES(hourlyRate), updatedAt=NOW();
